question: For each agency, show its id and how many active programs it runs.
reply:
```sql
SELECT agency.agency_id, COUNT(program.program_code) AS active_program_count
FROM agency
LEFT JOIN program ON agency.agency_id = program.agency_id AND program.is_active = 1
GROUP BY agency.agency_id;
```

```sql-unbound
SELECT agency.agency_id, COUNT(program.program_code) AS active_program_count
FROM agency
LEFT JOIN program ON agency.agency_id = program.agency_id AND program.is_active = :is_active

```
